notes: Hand-authored workspace-default binding for the Executive Summary v1 deck. Seven sponsor-facing slides: cover, headline findings, top risks, recommendations, effort/cost summary, engagement context, next steps. Cover + numeric stats come from engine outputs; the three narrative panels (findings, risks, recommendations) are filled with AI-written prose via `section.headline_findings`, `section.top_risks`, `section.executive_recommendations` (declared in `deliverable-templates/executive-summary.json`). Previous binding mapped these to raw `*.bulletList` engine dumps; that produced inappropriate sponsor-facing copy with domain-code prefixes. seed: {"name":"Executive Summary","version":"v1","kind":"EXECUTIVE_SUMMARY"}

entries.note: Cover slide hero + engagement-context slide row.
Sub-title on the cover; right column on the context slide.
Cover prepared-for block, context slide, next-steps footer.
Effort & cost slide header; repeated on context slide.
Cost (low) stat card — formatted with two decimals.
Confidence as a percentage on effort/cost + context slides.
Currency code printed alongside the cost stats.
AI-written headline findings — curated 5–7 sponsor-facing bullets, no domain-code prefixes. Replaces the previous findings.bulletList engine dump.
AI-written top-risks summary — curated bullets with impact + mitigation. Replaces the previous risks.bulletList dump.
AI-written priority recommendations — sponsor-facing, no priority/domain prefixes. Replaces the previous recommendations.bulletList dump.
ISO date in cover, every footer, and the closing slide.
